decisions.contested_2026: Contested 2026 renamings (GG 54101: Robert Sobukwe, KuGompo City, Xamdeboo, Bishop Limba, Ekhephini): applied now; the former names are shown.
decisions.nieu_bethesda: KwaNoheleni was not gazetted; the map shows Nieu-Bethesda, the official name. Recorded as a correction of the OSM label, not a renaming.
decisions.near_spellings: Near-spellings (Tabankulu, Messina, Mafikeng, Teslaarsdal and the other spelling or orthography corrections) are treated as renamings; the former forms are shown.
decisions.apartheid_era: Apartheid-era former names are included (Sophiatown shows Triomf, District Six shows Zonnebloem).
decisions.kzn_spellings: KwaZulu-Natal spelling changes (Tongaat, Umhlanga Rocks, Amanzimtoti, Umkomaas, Umdloti, Mkuze, Ixopo, Umzinto, Gingindlovu, Umbogintwini, Umtentweni, Inchanga, Mtunzini, Congella) show the established former English forms.
decisions.settlements: Renamed settlements and farm-named villages (Mpumalanga and elsewhere) are included, not only towns and cities.
decisions.rulings_on_excluded: Municipality and metro names stay excluded (not place renamings); registrations of existing or new names stay excluded (no former name); Makhado/Louis Trichardt and Mabatlane/Vaalwater were reverted, so the official name is already the former name and no override is needed; renamings known only from secondary sources (Butterworth, Middledrift, Verwoerdburg) are applied and flagged secondary-source.
decisions.display_rule: Former English/Afrikaans names are the primary labels on both basemaps and in both languages. Official current names stay searchable and are kept as metadata, never as the primary label. Overrides touch place labels only.

notes: Liberty labels places with coalesce(name_en, name); tile.liberty_label is what the map currently shows.

former_af differs from former_en only where an established Afrikaans form exists (OSM name:af or common usage: Grahamstad, Oos-Londen, Aliwal-Noord, Somerset-Oos, Barkly-Oos, Berlyn, Morganbaai, Warmbad); these forms are not from gazettes.
tile_feature_id is the MVT feature id in this snapshot; not guaranteed to be a stable OSM id.
Scope v1: towns, cities, suburbs and named settlements whose former name is an established English/Afrikaans name; village-level renamings in the SAGNC DB are listed as gaps, not entries.

v1.1.0: every entry has display (primary_en, primary_af, official, aliases), override (match, tile_feature_id, class, current_names, status), effective (from, to, basis) and source. The map shows display.primary_*; overrides.json is generated from this file by scripts/build-overrides.mjs.

override.match 'id' keys on the tile feature id plus class plus the exact current name(s); 'name-class' (class plus exact names, only where the feature was found at the entry's coordinates) is supported but not used in this version; 'none' means no override (not in the tiles, or reverted).
